title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: analyzing complex workflows, data scientists frequently work multiple related tables simultaneously: clinical demographics, longitudinal vitals, lab panels, crosswalk dictionaries, summary reports. Existing tools force analysts siloed, tabbed interfaces one table visible time. Switching back forth tabs breaks cognitive flow, obscures structural discrepancies, makes mental reconciliation column mappings error-prone. sideview replaces tabbed viewers hardware-accelerated 2D infinite canvas. can place number heterogeneous tabular datasets side--side, zoom pan freely across workspace, visually connect columns across tables interactive SVG splines, sort filter columns directly table headers, inspect inline SVG distribution sparklines, automatically detect categorical discrepancies, generate idiomatic tidyverse code pastes directly active RStudio script editor.
code: library(sideview)  # Launch side-by-side multi-table canvas in RStudio Viewer or Gadget Window sideview(patients, visits, lab_results, gt_summary)

title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: DOM Virtualization (VirtualTable): Renders datasets containing 100,000+ rows smoothly 60 FPS dynamically maintaining sliding window ~30 active <tr> elements spacer elements. Mouse Wheel Zoom: Smooth scaling centered cursor position (15% 350% zoom). Panning & Dragging: Click--drag navigation across infinite canvas, magnetic edge-docking table cards. Dual Synchronized Scrolling: Locks vertical rows (scrollTop) horizontal columns (scrollLeft) across linked tables. Navigation: Fit Arrange buttons, minimap (bottom-left; click jump, M hide), Ctrl+K find card column, double-click card title zoom . Full-data sort filter: Header sorts filters run whole table R, just rows screen.

title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: data.frame & tibble: Virtualized interactive grid cards. arrow::Table & Dataset: Zero-copy schema extraction previewing head(50) without materializing multi-gigabyte files. duckdb Connections: DBI query schemas previewing head(50) lazy counts. gt & flextable: Styled HTML display extracting raw data frames (x[["_data"]] / x[["body"]][["dataset"]]) tidyverse code generation. htmlwidgets: Embedded container cards.

title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: Interactive SVG Splines: Connect column ports across tables generate idiomatic tidyverse joins. Click right-click directly spline curves disconnect. Composite Multi-Key Joins: Draw multiple splines tables emit composite keys: Proactive Foreign Key Detection (sv_suggest_mappings()): Heuristic scoring engine (name similarity, type compatibility, Jaccard value overlap) automatically discovers candidate foreign keys renders animated dashed suggested splines (.sideview-spline-suggested) 1-click acceptance.

Join diagnostics (sv_join_diagnostics()): match rate ways, unmatched keys, 1:1 / 1:m / m:m relationship, rows per join type, NA / spacing / case problems keys, shown commit join.

what: Generate tidyverse Code for Automatic Discrepancy Cleaning and Crosswalks — sv_auto_clean_rules
title: Generate tidyverse Code for Automatic Discrepancy Cleaning and Crosswalks — sv_auto_clean_rules
text: Inspects discrepancy detection output pairwise column discrepancies (exact matches, fuzzy near-matches, missing levels), automatically synthesizing clean recoding rules using dplyr::case_when(). Handles casing differences, leading/trailing whitespace discrepancies, fuzzy string distance variations (Levenshtein distance <= 2).

title: Generate tidyverse Code for Automatic Discrepancy Cleaning and Crosswalks — sv_auto_clean_rules
code: sv_auto_clean_rules(   discrepancy_result,   df_name = "df",   col = "status",   default = col,   pipe = FALSE )  sv_code_auto_clean(   discrepancy_result,   df_name = "df",   col = "status",   default = col,   pipe = FALSE )

title: Generate tidyverse Code for Automatic Discrepancy Cleaning and Crosswalks — sv_auto_clean_rules
text: discrepancy_result discrepancy result list (returned sv_detect_discrepancies()) object containing fuzzy_matches, only_in_x, only_in_y, exact_matches. df_name Name data frame mutate. Defaults "df". Can NULL piped standalone expressions. col Column name recoded. Defaults "status". NULL, attempts extract discrepancy_result$from_col defaults "status". default Fallback value unmatched records. equal col, preserves unmatched records via .default = <col>. Set NULL omit default clause. pipe Logical; TRUE, emits piped syntax df %>% dplyr::mutate(...).

title: Generate tidyverse Code for Automatic Discrepancy Cleaning and Crosswalks — sv_auto_clean_rules
text: character string tidyverse code, NULL discrepancies require cleaning.

    gender,
    "male" ~ "Male",
